subject: collector_lease_observer
assertions: observer uses leaseClient.status only and exposes no claim, renew, takeover or release API
vacant lease is observed without acquiring authority
matching owner/workstation yields only a non-authoritative candidate fence
publication_fence remains null because a read cannot prove Firestore request-time lease liveness
lease held by another collector does not expose holder UID or workstation identity
lease read failure is sanitized and does not block the current unfenced publication path
invalid friendly line labels fail before any remote read
explicitly_not_proven: physical two-workstation same-line conflict and recovery
